summary: The tape is quiet for the book going into Thanksgiving (11-26 closed, 11-27 half day). There are no new filings on any holding beyond SAM's 11-19 8-K 5.02, and none of the in-window items is a 4.01, 4.02, new 5.02 or large 1.01/2.01 on a held name. KR's company-confirmed 12-03 call is now 5 trading days out (11-27, 11-30, 12-01, 12-02, 12-03), so any KR add from today carries high risk. UNFI (12-01) and BLBD (12-02) are the other names inside the window. ADSK and BBY both reported on 11-24, confirmed by 8-K 2.02 filings and post-print price-target headlines, which closes my high flag on ADSK. No item on BTC/ETH or the ETFs changes their risk; there has been no rates or Fed headline for a seventh session. Applying L2: every held and events-block name below carries a date taken from its own estimate and filings, not from silence.

notable.headline: No new item; company-confirmed 12-03 call enters the 5-day window today
notable.read: This continues the thread I set on 11-23 and 11-24, counting across the 11-26 closure. The open items going into the call are the same: the Grubhub sounding-out (no bid) and the baby-food report (no agency action). Neither has moved in three sessions, so neither is growing. Any KR add from today carries print risk.

notable.headline: Citigroup and D.A. Davidson Adjust Price Targets on Autodesk (11-25; 8-K 2.02 filed 11-24)
notable.read: This closes my 11-23 and 11-24 high flags: the 11-24 file estimate was right, as BBY's was, which makes the BLBD-style stale estimate the exception this week rather than the rule. The Citi link reads as a cut ($276 to $260). That is the only post-print direction signal in the input, and it is a single analyst, so the marks should say how the print landed.

notable.headline: Analysts Adjust Price Targets for Best Buy Following Recent Performance (11-25)
notable.read: Post-print follow-through: the Wedbush link reads as a raise ($85 to $100, Neutral kept), with Truist and Jefferies also moving. BofA's 11-20 memory-cost margin warning is still unanswered by anything in the input.

notable.headline: Symbotic Announces $7 Billion Expansion of Walmart Automation Agreement (11-24); Flipkart CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy to Step Down (11-25)
notable.read: Not held (sale approved 11-23, pending its own test). The Symbotic expansion is a multi-year automation capex commitment, and the Flipkart change is a subsidiary leadership change, not a WMT officer 5.02 in the input. The post-print run of PT raises and initiations (now William O'Neil at Buy) continues. The bullish drift since 11-10 has not broken. It is context for grading the sale, not a reason to revisit it.

notable.headline: No headline names the 11-17 8-K 1.01/2.03; it leaves the 7-day window
notable.read: It closes by expiry, unread, like SAM's 8.01, BLBD's 5.02 and FTDR's 5.02 before it. The same goes for UGI's 11-17 1.01/2.03 and UNFI's 11-17 7.01. Three filings aged out together without a headline, which says again that item numbers alone leave a recurring blind spot.
